indications_and_usage: Uses For temporary relief of pain and itching associated with: minor burns sunburn minor cuts scrapes insect bites minor skin irritations rashes due to poison ivy, poison oak, or poison sumac Dries the oozing and weeping of poison: ivy oak sumac
warnings: Warnings For external use only. Do not use on wounds or damaged skin When using this product do not get into eyes do not bandage tightly Stop use and ask a doctor if condition worsens symptoms last more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days Keep out of reach of children . If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
